title: Multi-League Season Results & Team Lookup
description: Get a season of match results with scores and 1X2 odds from OddsPortal, a league's team roster with standings, or a team profile by name.

mode.title: What to fetch
mode.description: Season results with odds, a league's team roster, or a team lookup by name.

sport.title: League
sport.description: Which competition to fetch. Ignored when leagueUrls is set.

season.title: Season
season.description: Season to fetch. Soccer-style seasons use YYYY-YYYY (a plain YYYY expands to YYYY-YYYY); calendar-year leagues (MLB, MLS, NPB, J1, K League) use YYYY; 'current' is the live season. Used in results and teams modes.

leagueUrls.title: League URLs
leagueUrls.description: Optional: one or more OddsPortal league or season-results URLs (any sport or league, e.g. https://www.oddsportal.com/football/england/premier-league-2024-2025/results/). Overrides League and Season.

teamQuery.title: Team name
teamQuery.description: Team to look up by name (teamSearch mode), e.g. Arsenal or Real Madrid.

includeOdds.title: Include odds
includeOdds.description: Add 1X2 average and maximum odds, bookmaker count and per-bookmaker prices to each result.

includeUpcoming.title: Include upcoming matches
includeUpcoming.description: Keep scheduled and in-progress matches; turn off to get only finished results.

enrichTeams.title: Fetch team profiles
enrichTeams.description: In teams and teamSearch modes, open each team's page for its full name, venue, city, country and coach. Adds one request per team.

regionalFallback.title: Regional edition fallback
regionalFallback.description: When a league-season is empty on the main domain, retry it on the same site's regional edition (a few competitions, e.g. ACB, only publish older seasons there). Only fires on empty results, so it does not change normal runs.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum records to return (1-10000). The run also stops when the source runs out of pages.
